svg.text: Hourly batch forecasting · static-first web · grounded AI agent · ₹0 / month · working name, final name in Phase 6
CAMS as issued, by lead time
4 vCPU / 16 GB runners · secrets · logs · free
Rules: weather = GFS archived as issued · CAMS = ADS as issued · obs delayed by measured lag
Uncertainty: conformal calibration → category probabilities · AQI from PM via the CPCB formula
Never: interpolate gaps > 2 h · drop ≥ 999 µg/m³ hours · trust raw fire counts
Run time target: < 10 min per hour · writes 1 commit to <name>-live
ruff · pytest · pandera contracts · train/serve parity test · CAMS ADS vs Open-Meteo parity
web typecheck + build · agent eval (≥ 100 questions, no invented numbers)
pinned uv.lock / package-lock · every artifact records commit + data + model revision
status.json: data age per source · stations reporting · model revision
failed run → email · 3 failures → "data delayed" banner on the site
Vercel AI SDK · tool calling · streaming
rate limit per IP · answer cache
ingest pulls every source (fallback chain, source-tagged)
pipeline writes raw / clean / features / forecast archive to the lake
weekly Register writes a new model version (only if it passed the gate)
pipeline calls /api/revalidate so pages refresh in seconds
pages read latest/*.json (cached at the edge until next revalidate)
agent tools read the same latest/*.json (one source of truth)
agent ↔ Redis (rate limit, cache) and ↔ LLM chain (fallback)
